Hello, I'm Matthew

Engineering with a focus on outcomes.

I'm a Principal Software Engineer working with TypeScript and .NET, with a background in applied mathematics and more than six years leading engineering teams. My interests centre on building reliable software and making data useful, particularly where they can support better health outcomes.
